rating.verdict: A proven Modern deck that can win on turn 2 by equipping Colossus Hammer for free. It still posts league 5-0s and Challenge top 8s in 2026, though it's less popular than the format's top decks.
strengths: Turn-2 kills: Puresteel Paladin or Battlefield Improvisation equips Colossus Hammer for free
Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga find the Hammer
Inkmoth Nexus gives a second, infect-based way to win
weaknesses: Instant-speed removal in response to the equip wastes a whole turn
Artifact hate (Force of Vigor, Haywire Mite) hurts
Draws without a creature-plus-Hammer pair are slow

wins: Put Colossus Hammer (+10/+10) on a cheap creature without paying its 8-mana equip cost, and win in one or two swings.
plan: Ornithopter (free), Esper Sentinel, Stoneforge Mystic or Puresteel Paladin, plus Mox Opal and Springleaf Drum.
Puresteel Paladin with 3+ artifacts makes equip cost 0. Battlefield Improvisation attaches every Equipment to an attacker for free. Stoneforge puts the Hammer straight in.
An Ornithopter with Hammer is an 11/11. Add Leyline Axe for double strike and trample: 24 damage.
keys: Attach after attackers are declared, so the Hammer’s flying loss doesn’t matter.
A land that makes Constructs and fetches cheap artifacts.
Surge of Salvation, Voice of Victory
Protect the big turn: hexproof for your team, or no spells for them on your turn.
tips: Leyline Axe in your opening hand can start the game on the battlefield for free.
Esper Sentinel taxes the opponent’s first spell each turn or draws you a card.
Metallic Rebuke can be paid for by tapping your artifacts.
mulligan: Keep a creature, an Equipment or Stoneforge, and a way to cheat the equip cost.
sideboard: Second set of Surge of Salvation
